description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'SecurityTestUtils' used for testing security-related functionalities in the book project. It provides methods to retrieve and insert a test user into the user repository, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: SecurityTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for testing security features, such as retrieving and inserting test users into the user repository.

methods.name: getTestUser
methods.description: Retrieves a test user from the repository using a predefined email, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: insertTestUser
methods.description: Creates and saves a new test user with a predefined email and password into the repository.
